registerNotes.intimate: तू is for very close friends and family. Practise this one with आप and तुम.

notes: Two ways to wish: ___ की शुभकामनाएँ ("good wishes for ___") and ___ मुबारक ("blessed ___"). Both fit any festival; ईद मुबारक and दिवाली की शुभकामनाएँ are the most usual.
The reply is आपको भी ("to you too").
At Diwali families visit each other with boxes of मिठाई. At Holi people throw colours, and at Eid there is sweet सेवइयाँ.
हम ... जाते हैं, हम ... खाते हैं: with हम the verb takes the plural -ते हैं, even for a group of women in everyday speech.
